title: Validate a cellID obtained from one offer's GetSeatMap response is rejected when submitted in Book for a different offer.
endpoint_or_flow: Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap (x2 offers) -> Book
request_summary: Book on offer E2 (BAH-JED 2027-06-20) with seat cellCode 8A but cellId = the cellID issued for seat 19A on a different offer E1 (BAH-JED 2027-06-19); two independent Search -> FareConfirm -> AddPassenger -> GetSeatMap chains
response_summary: 200 - pnr OOQACT ticketed (722137002461) after 31s; passengersSelectedSeats came back as an empty object {}; totalSelectedSeatsAmount 0.00; no error
expected: Request is rejected with a 4xx validation error (exact shape UNKNOWN per 7.9) because the cellID embeds the originating ResponseId/OfferId and is bound to the offer it was issued for
actual: STILL REPRODUCES (BUG-07). The foreign cellId was not rejected: Book ran the full supplier round-trip, created and ticketed a real booking, and silently dropped the seat instead of returning an error. New diagnostic this round: VAL-03 shows a valid same-offer cellId DOES attach (BUG-19 gone), so the drop here suggests the foreign token is detected as not-matching but is swallowed instead of rejected - the defect is the missing error.
evidence: Book 200 in 30502ms; pnr OOQACT, ticket 722137002461; passengersSelectedSeats {}; totalSelectedSeatsAmount 0 SAR

history: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); confirmed Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12, 13, 15 (Round 4 blocked by an outage); reproduced again Round 16 (2026-10-07).
summary: Book accepts a cellId that was issued for a different offer's seat: it runs the full booking, tickets it, and silently drops the seat (empty passengersSelectedSeats, no fee) instead of returning an error.
expected_value: 4xx validation error rejecting a cellId that does not belong to this offer, with no booking created
impact: A stale or foreign seat token yields a real ticketed booking with no seat and no error, so the caller believes the seat selection succeeded. With BUG-19 not reproducing this round, VAL-03 shows valid tokens attach, so the foreign token is evidently detected but swallowed rather than rejected.
evidence: Book on offer E2 (cellCode 8A) with the cellId of seat 19A from offer E1: 200, pnr OOQACT, ticket 722137002461, passengersSelectedSeats {}, totalSelectedSeatsAmount 0, no error.

short_name: Book silently drops a valid same-offer seat selection
note: Round 15 reproduced 2 of 2 (seats 12D, 10C dropped). Round 16 VAL-03 seat 17C on GF163 attached and persisted through Retrieve on the first attempt. Caveat: this flight prices every seat at 0 SAR, unlike the 60 SAR seats of Rounds 13/15, so re-verify on a flight with paid seats before closing; only 1 attempt this round.
